title: Effect of build orientation on marginal and internal discrepancies of zirconia crowns fabricated by using digital light processing 3D printing: A clinical study
html: Digital light processing (DLP) 3-dimensional (3D) printing enables the additive fabrication of monolithic zirconia crowns; however, the effect of build orientation on their marginal and internal discrepancies in vivo, relative to conventionally milled zirconia crowns, remains insufficiently characterized.
